# St Joseph's Curriculum Portal

> Free, offline-first UK National Curriculum portal (EYFS to Key Stage 4), Catholic faith sanctuary, procedural 3D British Sign Language (BSL) & Makaton interpreter, and deterministic `<35 KB` AST Vector Media Engine powered by native Web Standards and optional on-device edge AI (Gemini Nano, WebLLM, and W3C WebMCP).

St Joseph's Curriculum Portal operates with zero cloud data leakage, zero student tracking, and 100% offline execution via IndexedDB, a fixed 448 KB WebAssembly linear memory pool, and declarative S-Expression vector cartridges (`.ast` / `.astb`). Dual-licensed under GNU AGPLv3 / OGL v3.0 for schools and humanitarian education (Track A) and commercial terms for enterprise signage (Track B).

## Core Portal Endpoints
- [Portal Home](/): Overview, featured live simulation stage, and curriculum learning pathways
- [Interactive Science, Maths & Faith Labs](/player): 60 FPS AST Vector Media Player with 79 compiled interactive simulations & books, parameter controls, smartboard ink, procedural sonification, and lazy pure-SVG offline Flash `.swf` import (AVM1 Beta / core AVM2; zero `<canvas>` or WebGL)
- [Standalone Micro-Vector Player](/player.html): Embeddable zero-dependency vector stage, OBS broadcast link, and live SlideScript / AST Code Studio
- [Interactive Practice Lab](/practice-lab): Diagnostic curriculum drills with step-by-step hints and misconception checks
- [GCSE Exam Prep & Flashcards](/revision): AQA, Edexcel, and OCR 6-mark walkthroughs, active-recall flashcards, and audio dictation
- [Curriculum Lessons & Units](/learning-zone): Oak National Academy aligned lessons across Key Stages 1 to 4 plus installed overseas Ministry packs
- [Overseas Curriculums & Lesson Studio](/curriculum-studio): One-click Kenya KICD, India CBSE/NCERT, Ghana GES/NaCCA, and Philippines DepEd MATATAG syllabi, CSV/JSON pack importer, and offline `.astb` lab packager
- [Catholic Life & Faith Sanctuary](/catholic-life): High Altar anatomy, Church architecture 3D tour, Latin Mass prayers, Sacraments, and Catholic Social Teaching
- [EYFS & KS1 Phonics Lab](/phonics): DfE Phases 2–5 synthetic phonics sound mat, blending builder, and Year 1 screening check
- [Languages & Polyglot Studio](/languages): Spanish, French, German, and Ecclesiastical Latin phonics and verb conjugation wheels
- [Shakespeare Globe Theatre](/shakespeare): 1599 Wooden O 3D stage anatomy and annotated 5-Act play-throughs
- [Whole-Class Sync (Teacher Beacon)](/teacher-beacon): Peer-to-peer WebRTC classroom lesson synchronization without internet access
- [Student Progress & Badges](/profile): Private on-device mastery passport and UK MIS export tools
- [Accessibility & System Settings](/settings): High-contrast mode, font scaling, data saver, BSL/Makaton interpreter controls, and on-device AI status

## Featured STEM & Computing Cartridges
- [Kinetic Gas Theory & Boyle's Law](/player?preset=kinetic-gas): Molecular gas dynamics, PV = nRT pressure gauge, and phase transitions
- [Electrical Circuits & Ohm's Law](/player?preset=electric-circuits): Series and parallel circuits, knife switches, and live ammeter/voltmeter telemetry
- [Calculus: Tangent Slopes & Integrals](/player?preset=calculus-curves): Derivative tangent probes, turning points, and numerical integration
- [Pythagoras' Geometric Proof](/player?preset=pythagoras): Dynamic Euclidean area conservation and right-triangle proof
- [Solar System 3D Heliocentric Orbits](/player?preset=solar-system): Keplerian orbital mechanics, time-dilation warp, and 3D inclination camera
- [Bohr Atomic Structure](/player?preset=atom): Interactive electron shells, atomic mass/number, and 3D orbital tilt
- [Rates of Reaction](/player?preset=rates-of-reaction): Collision theory, activation energy, oscilloscope plotter, and conservation ledger
- [Acid-Alkali Titration](/player?preset=acid-alkali-titration): Equivalence curve plotting, pH indicator transitions, and burette control
- [DNA Double Helix & Transcription](/player?preset=dna-helix): 3D base-pair hydrogen bonding and interactive strand unzipping
- [Photosynthesis & Water Cycle](/player?preset=photosynthesis): Chloroplast light/Calvin reactions alongside Earth hydrology simulations
- [Jacob's Ladder of Prime Bricks](/player?preset=jacobs-ladder-primes): Interactive Riemann Hypothesis lab with the Critical Line ($\sigma = 0.5$), 15 clickable zeta zeros, and live $\pi(x)$ vs $\text{Li}(x)$ alignment
- [Modular Brick Engineering & Vector Racing](/player?preset=modular-bricks): 3D spatial geometry construction (`modular-bricks`) and continuous keyboard-driven kinematics (`vector-racing`)
- [Inverted Pendulum & BBC Micro 6502](/player?preset=pendulum_dyno): Cart-pole control systems (`pendulum_dyno`) and historical Acorn MOS 6502 computing (`bbc-model-b`)

## Humanities, Literacy & Catholic Sanctuary Cartridges
- [Decodable Phonics Storybooks (Levels 1–5)](/player?preset=reader-pat-sat): 5 illustrated offline UK DfE phonics books (`reader-pat-sat`, `reader-red-dog`, `reader-ship-rain`, `reader-frog-log`, `reader-cake-lake`) with sound buttons and word-tap TTS
- [3D BSL Two-Handed Fingerspelling](/player?preset=bsl-fingerspelling): 360-degree Signer and Receiver POV British Sign Language alphabet rig
- [Sacred Church Architecture 3D Tour](/player?preset=church-tour): Nave, sanctuary, tabernacle, ambo, and baptismal font exploration
- [High Altar Anatomy](/player?preset=altar-anatomy): Mensa, altar stone, GIRM candle rubrics, tabernacle, and sacred vessels
- [Order of the Mass & Seven Sacraments](/player?preset=order-of-the-mass): Liturgical structure, sacramental rites, and bilingual Latin/English responses
- [Stations of the Cross & Holy Rosary](/player?preset=stations-of-the-cross): 14 Via Dolorosa stations and 3D chaplet mysteries
- [System Architecture Manifesto](/player?preset=lumina-architecture): Interactive 4-chapter technical Slide deck of the Lumina AST Vector Engine

- [Dual-Licensing Charter](/licensing): Open Government Licence v3.0 & GNU AGPLv3 humanitarian terms vs commercial licensing
- [Privacy & KCSIE Child Safety](/privacy): Zero-cloud student data architecture, UK GDPR Art. 25, and safeguarding policies
